opportunities.title: Background and foreground colors do not have a sufficient contrast ratio.
opportunities.description: Low-contrast text is difficult or impossible for many users to read. [Learn how to provide sufficient color contrast](https://dequeuniversity.com/rules/axe/4.11/color-contrast).

opportunities.title: Form elements do not have associated labels
opportunities.description: Labels ensure that form controls are announced properly by assistive technologies, like screen readers. [Learn more about form element labels](https://dequeuniversity.com/rules/axe/4.11/label).

opportunities.title: Displays images with incorrect aspect ratio
opportunities.description: Image display dimensions should match natural aspect ratio. [Learn more about image aspect ratio](https://developer.chrome.com/docs/lighthouse/best-practices/image-aspect-ratio/).

opportunities.title: Document does not have a valid `rel=canonical`
opportunities.description: Canonical links suggest which URL to show in search results. [Learn more about canonical links](https://developer.chrome.com/docs/lighthouse/seo/canonical/).

opportunities.title: `[aria-*]` attributes do not match their roles
opportunities.description: Each ARIA `role` supports a specific subset of `aria-*` attributes. Mismatching these invalidates the `aria-*` attributes. [Learn how to match ARIA attributes to their roles](https://dequeuniversity.com/rules/axe/4.11/aria-allowed-attr).

opportunities.title: Document doesn't have a valid `hreflang`
opportunities.description: hreflang links tell search engines what version of a page they should list in search results for a given language or region. [Learn more about `hreflang`](https://developer.chrome.com/docs/lighthouse/seo/hreflang/).

opportunities.title: Forced reflow
opportunities.description: A forced reflow occurs when JavaScript queries geometric properties (such as offsetWidth) after styles have been invalidated by a change to the DOM state. This can result in poor performance. Learn more about [forced reflows](https://developer.chrome.com/docs/performance/insights/forced-reflow) and possible mitigations.

opportunities.title: Links rely on color to be distinguishable.
opportunities.description: Low-contrast text is difficult or impossible for many users to read. Link text that is discernible improves the experience for users with low vision. [Learn how to make links distinguishable](https://dequeuniversity.com/rules/axe/4.11/link-in-text-block).
